translations.web: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
translations.bsb: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.
translations.kjv: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is ➔ not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.
translations.asv: It is actually reported that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not even among the Gentiles, that one of you hath his father's wife.
